acceptance: .build/ is ignored or no longer generated in worktrees, verified by git status staying clean after a commit that runs the hooks
No committed file relies on the untracked .build/ contents
context: Observed in every implementation worktree this session (oracle, ssb, explorer, validate-corpus, tpcds-obt, ssb-sql, dryrun, tuning, subscale) and in the benchbox-site worktree; each worker had to delete it before publishing. Root cause not diagnosed: find which hook/tool writes it (candidates: pre-commit/commit hooks) before choosing ignore-vs-stop-generating.
description: Commit hooks generate an untracked .build/ directory in every worktree (BenchBox and benchbox-site). .gitignore covers build/ but not .build/, so git status is dirty after every commit until the directory is deleted by hand. It carries no source, but it pollutes status checks and forced a manual rm -rf .build step in every implementation cycle this session.
